• LEFT FIELD

ZINE 3

A month’s worth of short digressions
Ft. the omnipresence of neglected responsibility

November 4.
10:08am
(a Monday morning. There is much work to be done.)
The thing that gets me about a zine is its nonvisuality
(Is that a real word? Or did I make it up…who’s to say. Autocorrect gives it a pass, so I do too)
So sharing a zine means unzipping my brain and sharing my haphazard collection of thoughts
Polished up perhaps, but unlike a photo or a collage, there’s no possible separate visual appreciation that could be had.
To be known is worse than being naked.
The body is a product of the mind.
Does anyone ever read a zine and be like “brother euhhh?”
(Let me know in the comments below!)

I jest, actually. Keep those comments in your head (the way I wish I could keep these thoughts in my head and lock in my statistics homework gah)
I’m prescribing a one-way street of zine consumption
Unless you have a digression of your own, in which case
Please!
Make a zine yourself
We can beef it out like opposing column writers, it’ll be fun :)

November 12
1:02am
One part I love about coding is the period of time waiting for (non buggy) code to run in its entirety
The decision of what I do in this period is between me and God
Technically on the clock but really,
These
  minutes
    escape
Like November daydreams or M&Ms around unwatched children
Unremembered, fleeting, and only to be savored in the moment

1:28am
If I had to pick any three words to encapsulate the greatest pressure of the last two weeks, it would be: LOCK IN BRO

Two days ago:
“Oh shit; oh fuck,” I remarked,
upon thinking I lost my passport

November 23, 2024
2:29pm
I’m on a flight to layover in Beijing—
broken laptop, stomach full of a concoction of four drinks, peeling cuticles, a $2 piece of raw chocolate in backpack, 1583 almonds in the check in baggage, 200 won in my pocket, 1056/2000 words of my essay written (it was due last Tuesday),
What is life if not for this!

December 3, 2024
2:31am
(I can’t sleep. Self-imposed midnight bedtime largely unsuccessful.)

Is the worship of aesthetics a sin?
It dances the line between the physical and the intangible
Through the collective of the physical, manifests the aesthetic
Cutting out all else along the way

Later that day
12:26pm
I have a final in 4.5 hours
Instead of actually looking at three dimensional random walks and properties of random sums, I’ve figured that I really ought to be calculating what would be the OPTIMAL time to caffeinate so that way the caffeine hits but I won’t be pissing my pants mid question 3 of the test

December 9
3:06pm
i’m on my way to Pasir Ris, so far from Sheares…
i just cried on the train, head bowed

all those homework and tests and grades from a week ago and more
all those troubles seem so far away
my head and heart are full
of ache

physically and mentally raw from each goodbye, each 5am bedtime
but each one worth it because that’s the price of having known all these people who,
somehow,
snuck their way into meaning something so dear, so near to me
